mechanics.claim: Killing the target with the empowered attack refunds the mana cost and reduces the cooldown to 1 second; otherwise the target-not-killed case grants a 5s on-hit magic damage buff.
mechanics.quote: If ''Seastone Trident'' kills its target, the {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced to 1 second and the {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} is refunded. Otherwise, if the target is not killed, '''Fizz's''' basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}} for the next 5 seconds.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts after the active is used/resolved, not on cast.
The empowered attack resets Fizz's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Seastone Trident {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Fizz's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: The passive bleed refreshes its duration on subsequent basic attack hits rather than stacking as a separate instance.
mechanics.quote: dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack applies spell damage, while the DoT is persistent/indirect damage and the on-hit bonus is proc damage; this affects how each interacts with damage amps/reductions.
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|spell damage}} on the empowered attack, {{tip|persistent damage}} additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage}} on the damage over time effect, and {{tip|proc damage}} on the bonus damage on-hit.

mechanics.claim: Dodging, blocking, or blinding negates the passive bleed damage entirely.
mechanics.quote: The passive bonus damage gets negated by {{tip|dodge|dodging}} or {{tip|block|blocking}} the attack, or if '''Fizz''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.

mechanics.claim: If the target dodges the active or Fizz is blinded, the empowered attack deals no damage but is not consumed; if the target blocks, the attack deals no active damage despite being consumed, but still applies the passive bleed.
mechanics.quote: If the attacked enemy is {{tip|dodge|dodging}} or if '''Fizz''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}, the empowered attack won't deal any damage, but the empowered attack won't be consumed.
